name: select
description: Accessible select built on the native <select> with flat options, optgroups, a placeholder row and native multi-select.
designIntent: Native selects keep platform keyboard, mobile picker and screen-reader behavior for free. Groups cover coarse categorization, placeholder renders the 'choose one' affordance, and multiple switches the contract to string[] for tag-picker use cases without reimplementing a listbox.

props.name: options
props.description: Flat options ({ value, label, disabled? }). Ignored when groups is provided.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label rendered and associated via htmlFor/aria

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value (string, or string[] when multiple).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired with the new value; string[] when multiple.

props.name: groups
props.description: Optgroups: [{ label, options }] rendered with a heading per section.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Renders a disabled empty option as the 'choose one' affordance.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Native multi-select; value/defaultValue/onChange switch to string[].

examples.title: Grouped options
examples.code:
<Select
  label="Plan"
  placeholder="Choose a plan"
  groups={[
    { label: 'Individual', options: [{ value: 'free', label: 'Free' }] },
    { label: 'Business', options: [{ value: 'team', label: 'Team' }] },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Multi-select
examples.code:
<Select
  label="Channels"
  multiple
  value={channels}
  onChange={setChannels}
  options={[{ value: 'email', label: 'Email' }, { value: 'slack', label: 'Slack' }]}
/>
examples.description: Native listbox with a string[] contract.

examples.title: Controlled select
examples.description: Keep the selected value in state and render it back through value.

antiPatterns.title: Do not build a custom listbox for simple choices
antiPatterns.explanation: Hand-rolled listboxes rarely match native keyboard and screen-reader behavior. Use Select for flat option lists; consider CommandPalette for searchable command surfaces.

accessibility.implementation: A visible label is connected with htmlFor/id; without one, aria-label is forwarded to the native select.
Built on the native select element, inheriting its full support matrix.

compositionRules.relationship: Pair Select with Button in filter toolbars; Button submits, Select filters.
